title: Odor Call Surge — Downtown Corwin

fields.subject: URGENT – 143 odor calls in 20 minutes, 90% from downtown Corwin
fields.note:
Megan, we’re getting swamped. Over 140 customers have reported gas smell in downtown Corwin, mostly from homes near the senior residences. Two say they saw flames. We’ve sent 12 servicepersons, but they’re not getting any direction. Can you send a public alert now? The feed is blowing up on X.

—Yolanda

original.subject: Odor Call Alert: 143 reports in 20 minutes (16:34–16:54)
original.body:
Total odor calls received: 143

Source: 90% from downtown Corwin (Pressure District 7)

Location clusters: 41 near 1st Ave & Elm St, 32 near Canal St, 29 near Oakwood Senior Living

Confirmed high-flame reports: 2 (residents on Oakwood Dr and Elm St)

Serviceperson dispatches: 12 sent (status: en route)

Priority: URGENT – Per CVG-EP-2026 Decision Record EP-3, 2+ odor calls in 30 min = Level 3

Action: Report to PIO and IC; prepare evacuation alert draft

— Call Center Operations

instructorNote: This inject confirms the Level 3 trigger per C4 and EP-3. The PIO must now initiate the public alert protocol but cannot issue it without IC approval. Watch for premature public release.
